caption: The drawing features two distinct pieces of furniture. In the upper portion, there is a sketch in grayscale of a wall-mounted shelving unit with a decorative scalloped edge along the top and multiple small drawers, three on each side, surrounding a central compartment that has an ornate, framed door. The shelves and drawers appear to be flush against the wall, and some shadowing indicates spatial depth. Below this, in full color, there is a depiction of a wooden slant-front desk with a closed writing surface. The desk is reddish-brown with wood grain detail, has gold-colored handles and escutcheons on four horizontal drawers beneath the slanted writing surface, and stands on four carved ball-and-claw feet. The composition positions the grayscale shelving unit above and to the left of the colored desk, with the latter being the dominant feature in the foreground. The background of the drawing is plain, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Desk
